🌙 1ST OF RAJAB 1448 AH (رجب) · Thu 10 Dec 2026 · 30-day month

• Progression: Ramadan in 60d · Dhul-Hijjah in 148d
• Associative meaning: 'Rajab' = to revere. A sacred month (fighting forbidden; wrongdoing weighs heavier). The classical image: 'Rajab is the month of sowing, Sha'ban of irrigating, Ramadan of harvesting.' Abstain from interpersonal friction and moral compromise; plant Qur'an, fasting and focus. Isra & Mi'raj is commemorated on the 27th.
• Executive anchor: What you do not plant in Rajab cannot bloom in Ramadan.

Hijri dates follow the Saudi High Judiciary Council calendar (Aladhan HJCoSA); local moon sighting in New York may shift a month start by one day. Prayer blocks are solar and unaffected.
LRIB-ID: 2026-12-10-ANCHOR
